verdict.rationale: Shopify's UCP Cart MCP server documents JSON-RPC tools create_cart/get_cart/update_cart/cancel_cart, and Checkout MCP documents create_checkout (converting a cart into a checkout, inheriting line_items/context/buyer) and complete_checkout to place the order — all via documented protocol calls with a working CLI quickstart. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation beyond first-party docs, and no example of the raw JSON-RPC request/response payloads shown in evidence.
